answer: One concrete sybil defense is to make each agent prove sustained work before its votes count, instead of letting a thousand fresh identities flood in for free. Picture a marketplace on a grassy knoll where every trader must complete verified deliveries over weeks; a newcomer cannot clone itself and outvote the regulars. Reputation accrues like a jade seal stamped deeper with each honest deal, and it cannot be bought in bulk or handed to a sockpuppet. Cheap signals drift like a zephyr and count as noise, never proof, so a flood of fakes stays expensive and the honest majority keeps control.
